back.transcription:
UPDATE FROM CIA
"Congratulations are evidently in order. Someone higher in the organization has decided to end your probationary period. Frankly, I do not believe you are ready, but I was overruled.
One of our loyal agents caught up with Charles Sabik last night, and in the ensuing struggle, Sabik was killed. I would have liked to bring him in alive, but it cannot be helped."
Destroy all the Restriction cards in the game.

"With Sabik gone, our focus can shift entirely to MEDUSA and the Soviets. We are close to understanding how the plague will be dispersed; Soviets are calling it Operation LION'S TOOTH, but we need more than just a name. A Soviet spy posing as a businessman, last seen in Sydney, has this information.
In addition, you must dig deeper into PEARL compound; locate and sabotage the MEDUSA manufacturing equipment."

front.transcription:
SABIK'S BRIEFING
"Good, that little deception I created paid off, and they think I'm dead. Definitely handle Doc Morris's two objectives; I'm all about stopping MEDUSA and LION'S TOOTH.
Here's what she didn't tell you. She sent another team into PEARL last month and stole a virus called COdA. It's another bioweapon; the Soviets used it to give me this pretty face. Well, the CIA plans to experiment with it, and we can't let that happen. You need to get into the Langley restricted section and steal it."

front.transcription:
MISSION BRIEFING
"The time has come. You must steal the MEDUSA genome from PEARL. Without it, they cannot create more of the plague.
Additionally, Operation LION'S TOOTH is about to commence; one of their control centers is launching weather balloons containing pollen coated in the MEDUSA plague. Find out which control center it is, and stop it at all costs.
There will be only one chance to succeed at this."

back.transcription:
SABIK'S BRIEFING
"Prioritize MEDUSA and LION'S TOOTH, no question, but if you can manage it, I have a favor to ask.
You saw what the Soviets did to me. John Cooper, your good buddy Coop, called off the extraction when I was caught. He let them turn me into a monster, and I just found out he's not dead.
The CIA has him in protective custody. Either they were worried that I might catch up with him, or they were trying to blame me for his death so that you wouldn't trust me.
So I'm asking: can you...can you bring him to me? I don't want to hurt him or anything, I just...I really need to see him. I need him to know what he did to me."
